timeless_wisdom.quote_text: The steadfast love of the Lord endures forever. Day 1
timeless_wisdom.author: Charles Spurgeon

scripture.text: Selected passage for day 1 from Genesis 1-2. Read the referenced verses in your primary Bible text for full context.

exposition.text: Day 1 focuses on Genesis 1-2. The passage in Genesis 1-2 (Day 1) reveals that God creates with intention and order, inviting trust rather than anxiety. This context calls the reader to receive identity as gift, not achievement. The text grounds obedience in grace and directs attention to God's character. Because the Lord is faithful, daily decisions can be shaped by worship, truth, and practical love for neighbor in ordinary moments. The bridge to application is not self-reliance but response to what God has already spoken and accomplished. Day 1 focuses on Genesis 1-2.
